This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. [[Gorg Singo]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|green]] skin and large heads with wideset [[eye]]s.<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Kenobi date">{{KenobiDate|I}}</ref> a member of this species, [[Gorg Singo]], departed from a [[Unidentified two-engined passenger transport|passenger transport]] parked at the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]], passing by the [[Exile (punishment)|exiled]] [[Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] who intended to board the same shuttle on a mission to save a young [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia]].<ref name="Kenobi I" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:GorgSingo-ConceptArt.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Concept art by Dylan Howie-Richardson]]
This species first appeared in the [[Part I|first episode]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'' limited television series, directed by [[Deborah Chow]]<ref name="Kenobi I" />and aired on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Companion">{{InsiderCite|214|Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi Companion|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi'' Companion}}</ref> The species was initially designed by [[Dylan Howie-Richardson]], before being expanded upon by makeup prosthetic artist [[Shaun Smith]] and team.<ref name="Concept">{{ArtStation|username=django42|url=artwork/G85bG3|name=[[Dylan Howie-Richardson]]|text=Obi-Wan Kenobi alien concept designs (1)|date=2022-11-28|quote=Work I did for the Obi-Wan Kenobi series on Disney+ designing makeup prosthetics. Featured are designs of aliens for Mos Eisley in Episode 1.}}</ref>
